Fixed a bug where the user is sometimes unable to progress to Attic
Fixed a bug where the player can get stuck on the ceiling fan

Fixed a bug where the red stop sign on the voice recorder persists after the balloon disappears in Attic

notes.title: YOLKED Full Release Is Out Now!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the full release of the game YOLKED! Our team has poured their hearts and souls into creating this game, fueled by their passion and dedication, and we're excited to share it with gamers all over the world. 🥳

In this full release, we've added a brand ✨new final level✨ called "Tree" that has a completely different atmosphere than any other level in the game. Players will be challenged in new ways as they navigate this beautiful and mysterious level. 🌲

Additionally, we've included a captivating final cutscene that ties together the story of the game, providing players with a satisfying conclusion to our Egg’s journey. Furthermore, we've added many more exciting new collectibles for players to find and enjoy. Check out our lists of new features and bug fixes below to learn more about what is available in this update!

[h3]New Features ✨[/h3]
[list]
[*] Our final campaign level, Tree, is now available! 
[*] Game now supports 7 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
[*] Added 10+ new collectibles, including a Pixelated costume, a Glass costume and a Planet costume
[*] Added a final cutscene
[*] Updated the credits
[*] Added subtitles to voice recordings in Attic level
[*] Added a new way to get special collectibles by entering a secret code in the text field on the Collectibles menu
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes & Adjustments 🐞[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the chalkboard is sometimes in the wrong location during restart
[*] Fixed a bug where the user is sometimes unable to progress to Attic
[*] Fixed a bug where the player can get stuck on the ceiling fan
[*] Fixed a bug in Endless Winter where icicles would sometimes have erratic behaviors
[*] Fixed a bug where the red stop sign on the voice recorder persists after the balloon disappears in Attic
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323188/c85dbcf4b5365f4e29b6698ce8d2950a6f879f7e.gif[/img]

Thank you to everyone who has supported us along the way, and we hope you enjoy YOLKED!

notes.title: Patch 0.17 Christmas Special
notes.content:
YOLKED is starting off your holidays with their Christmas event, Eggsmas, with exclusive jolly collectibles, a menu that sleighs, music to make the jingle bells rock, and you snow the drill: an endless winter game mode that gets harder and harder the longer you go! How long will you last as you dash across the night sky for Eggsmas? This event runs for a limited time from Dec.15th-Jan.5th! 🎄

We're also introducing a new campaign level: [b]Garden[/b]! Explore the outdoors in YOLKED’s third level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323188/1817889eb9ba7941de539d393fd5af54f674a913.png[/img]

[h2]New Features 🎁[/h2] 
[list]
[*] An entirely new campaign level: [b]Garden[/b]! Explore the outdoors in YOLKED’s third level! The Garden level is much longer than Kitchen and Attic with completely new enemies and obstacles.
[*] An entirely new Endless level: [b]Endless Winter[/b]! Endless Winter is a chamber level where enemies spawn endlessly. Try to get a high score!
[*] New Collectibles: A lot of new Garden collectibles and 4 new Endless Winter collectibles!
[*] Leaderboards now include Garden and Endless Winter
[*] Added a new Christmas main menu jingle
[*] Added new Christmas decorations in the main menu
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes & Adjustments 🐞[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Fixed inconsistent HP displayed when player opens game
[*] Updated dropdown highlight color
[*] Adjusted Endless Kitchen segment boundary length
[*] Fixed settings menu navigation
[*] Fixed a bug where wheels of toy trolley clips into the ground
[/list]

[h2]Coming Soon[/h2]
FULL RELEASE in February! 🎉

notes.title: Patch 0.16: Theggsgiving Special
notes.content:
Grab your knives and forks gentleyolks as we are about to dive into Theggsgiving. So grab onto your shells; ‘cause you ain’t seen stuffing yet.

Hungry? Activate: Feast Mode. With a scavenger hunt and giant dishes of delicious food, it doesn’t get butter than this. Overstuffed already? Why not collect some new Theggsgiving cosmetics so when your family asks what you were doing: let’s give ‘em pumpkin to talk about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323188/007360a2828166f2a8880feb2ed6831e50612b37.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Features [/b]🎊[/h3]
Players can go on a scavenger hunt in Campaign and take photos of Thanksgiving dishes! 🦃
Players can unlock two new Thanksgiving-themed collectibles during the event 🍂
Added a Thanksgiving-themed ambiance to the main menu ✨

[h3][b]Bug Fixes & Adjustments [/b]🪲[/h3]
Added a quarter-second grab buffer so that players don’t have to be as precise with their grab inputs
Adjusted bunsen burner colliders in Attic
Fixed Attic lab section fire not setting the player ablaze
Added input for going to the previous menu
Fixed unobtainable ice cream costume in Kitchen wine glass section
Fixed a bug in the tutorial where icons would not disappear

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323188/bd124aad285553955a53f0442ff8bcac828d204d.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Coming Soon[/b][/h3]
Stay tuned for an exciting Christmas event next month! Spoiler alert: there’s new content! 🎄
The Christmas update will be a HUGE update where we’ll be releasing a brand new Campaign level and a completely new Christmas-themed Endless level! 

And for Theggsgiving, we are giving thanks (or theggs, whichever one you prefer) to all our wonderful players for supporting us, this is for you good eggs out there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323188/d6ff1c7afd9474af03553b15c7d6b74df91449ae.jpg[/img]

Finally, Christmas is lurking around the corner, it’s going to be big, the fun will be endless, ‘cause bready or not, here we crumb, see you guys in the next update!

notes.title: Dev Diary (10/18/22)
notes.content:
[b]Dev Diary (10/18/22)[/b]
Hey everyone! Hope you're all doing well! [h1]😳 It’s been a while…[/h1] Although you haven’t heard from us in these past months, we have been working 😓 very hard on YOLKED with the goal of giving you the best version of the game possible!

Some of you may have been wondering [b]why the full version of YOLKED isn't released yet.[/b] 😅 Well…there were some big changes in our lives–graduation, moving countries and job hunting that unfortunately required us to push the release date :( BUT we have a lot of BIG updates coming up that we’re really excited about and we can’t wait for you to see what we’ve been up to!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323188/895ec138499b6a42f5c0f5915e06b7d38f84468e.png[/img]



[h2]This past year has been filled with 🐞[/h2]  bug-fixing, updating graphics, optimizing performance, increasing the number of collectibles, polishing the last two levels and implementing [b]leaderboards[/b] (can you believe it? We have leaderboards now!). We loved seeing players speedrunning Kitchen and Attic and wanted to encourage more players to challenge themselves by introducing leaderboards in the game. The leaderboards will show the 🚀 top 10 players and their times after completing Kitchen and Attic. Players will also be able to see their own times and ranking if they don’t make it to the top 10. Currently, the leaderboards show both Kitchen and Attic with two metrics, but we have plans to increase this to more metrics and more levels, including Endless Mode.

[h2]We had the idea of leaderboards a while ago,[/h2] but we were always hesitant to implement it because of how much time we thought it would take and how difficult it would’ve been to implement. However, we realized how many players would enjoy the leaderboards and also how we can easily build more content revolving around this feature, so it became one of our higher priorities 🤠. We hope this feature will encourage more players to try speedrunning the game and share speedrunning tactics in our Discord community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323188/166a39428547a28b7a8d1a647ddae4c6805c0064.gif[/img]

On that note, [b]we have just released a new Steam update[/b] which includes this leaderboard feature and the other changes mentioned above!

[h2]Another big adjustment[/h2] we have in this update is that new collectibles have been added and all collectibles have been shuffled. Unfortunately, this means [b]everyone will lose their progress, including their collectibles[/b]. This was a very 😬 tough decision but since we added a LOT more collectibles in Kitchen, Attic, and the two hidden levels, we wanted to make sure they were placed in the most appropriate locations and paired with the best descriptions. This change meant that everyone’s 💾 save file will reset, but luckily this will only happen this one time. We’re eager to see everyone’s reactions to the new costumes and we hope you like them as much as we do!

We also have a[b] fun event coming up[/b] next week on 🎃 [b]October 21, 2022: our very first Halloween event[/b] 👻, where players will be able to unlock exclusive collectibles!

Finally, we are thrilled to announce that our new full release date will be in [b]🎉 February 2023! 🎉[/b]

[h2][b]TL;DR[/b][/h2]
A new Steam update has been released, including a new leaderboards feature!
Since we added new collectibles and shuffled them around, unfortunately everyone will lose their progress in the game
On October 21, 2022, there will be a Halloween event where players can unlock exclusive Halloween costumes!
Our new full release date is now in February 2023!

- HardBoiled Studios

notes.title: Patch 0.14: Leaderboards and New Collectibles!
notes.content:
We’ve been working rigorously on the last 2 levels. While we can’t release the levels yet, this update contains lots of improvements and features preparing for the February release and the spooky event we are planning for this Halloween.

Due to changes to collectible locations and game infrastructure, all previous player progress will be lost with this update.

[h3]😎 New Features[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Added online leaderboards
[*] Added tons of new collectibles!
[*] Added an intro cutscene
[*] Redesigned and improved main menu!
[*] Added new story elements and audio tapes in Kitchen and Attic!
[*] Added new voice lines to background eggs
[*] Added an optional health counter
[/list]

[h3]🐞Bug Fixes & Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shuffled collectible locations
[*] Improved game stability
[*] Greatly decreased game disk and download size
[*] Adjusted egg physics so that pull up boosts are now easier to perform
[*] Improved frame rate and performance in Attic
[*] Adjusted game difficulty and level design in Attic
[*] Added more crack levels to the egg
[*] Checkpoints now heal the egg
[*] Improved lighting in Attic
[*] Fixed first checkpoint of Kitchen and Attic not working
[*] And many more minor fixes and adjustments
[/list]

[h3]COMING SOON[/h3]
💀Stay tuned for a spooky Halloween event and collectibles!🎃

notes.title: Patch 0.3: Speedrun Timers, Death Counter, Improved Graphics
notes.content:
[h2]What a sunny side up day for a YOLKED update![/h2]
Today’s update includes the long-awaited speedrun features including an on-display stopwatch and timing for individual game levels, as well as adjustments to give you more control over your egg-scape.

[h2]Patch 0.3[/h2]
[h3]New Features 🤩[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Added graphics settings including screen resolution selection and fullscreen options
[*] Increased graphics quality [/list]
[h3]Speedrun Additions ⏱[/h3]
[list]
[*] On-display stopwatch
[*] Total Timer: Shows current total time
[*] Detailed Timer: Shows current timings for individual levels
[*] On-display death counter
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323188/e2ce30afc94df3908802a471fe9ec45b427cd126.gif[/img]
[i] How many times have you died so far in-game? Guestimations are welcome~ [/i]🤯

[list]
[*] Adjusted hand physics to allow freer movement

[*] Hands no longer collide with each other

[*] Hands can now grab faster in succession, with the grab cooldown decreased from 0.3s ➡️ 0.2s
[*] Adjusted indoor and outdoor wallpapers in Kitchen
[*] Adjusted shaking drawer timings in Attic
[*] Added more story elements in Attic
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes 🐞[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the tutorial to occasionally not end after leaving the tutorial area
[*] Fixed eggshells going through the microwave in Kitchen
[/list]
[h2]COMING SOON:[/h2]
[i]Patch 0.4 on December 23[/i]
On December 23rd, YOLKED will return with an expansive update to playable levels and more. Look forward to it and have a safe holiday season!

notes.title: Patch 0.2: Attic Level Expansion, Save System Changes, New Skins
notes.content:
[h2]Hi there, yolks![/h2]
Welcome to our first expansive patch update, 0.2. From new challenging areas in the Attic level to free default skins for your egghead, this update should have you scrambling back to the egg carton.

[h2]Patch 0.2[/h2]
[h3]New Features 🤩[/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 new challenge sections within the Attic
[*] New default skins for your egg
[*] New collectible skins! Keep your eyes peeled for:[/list][I][olist]
[*] 🦃Turkey Egg Costume
[*] 🏳️‍🌈Pride Egg Costume
[*] 🤵Egg in Suit Costume
[*] 🔎Transparent Skin
[/olist]
[/i]

       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323188/724186c95e86056c7b628e94daea6ef9fe86107c.gif[/img]
       [i]I'd watch out for that spiky spider egg if I were you...[/i]

[h3]Bug Fixes & Adjustments 🐞[/h3]
Unfortunately, with more content comes growing pains. In order to set up a proper foundation for this and future updates to YOLKED levels, we had to adopt a new save filing system in this patch. This means that [b]your save file and checkpoint data up until this point will be lost.[/b]

That being said, this will be the only time in which an update will result in a lost save file. And those new collectible skins we’ve mentioned? You just might find them in the previous Kitchen and Attic areas! 👀 Thank you for bearing with us as we improve YOLKED and its system!

[b]1. Quality of Life Adjustments[/b]
[list][*] Game now autosaves when a checkpoint is acquired
[*] Game now pauses when a controller disconnects
[*] Game now pauses when the game window is not in focus
[*] Cursor is now hidden when playing with the controller
[*] Decreased difficulty of carousel cage jumps
[*] Added prompts to self-destruct when egg becomes stuck[/list]
[b]2. Longevity Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated Unity engine to a more stable version
[*] Save files are now encrypted
🥚[i]Previous save files will be lost upon this update only. Future updates to the save filing system will not remove player progress.[/i][/list]
[b]3. Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that regressed player progress when a previously uncollected checkpoint was collected (out of order)
[*] Fixed a bug causing tutorial indicator icons to get stuck if the player moved the cursor while playing with the controller
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.1 Bug Fixes, Optimizations, FMOD Integration, + LEVEL PREVIEWS
notes.content:
[h2]Good eggs: It’s time for a patch update! [/h2]

Since YOLKED launched into Early Access on October 28, we’ve had the absolute joy of watching creators play our challenging egg game.
[previewyoutube=BADymc59IzM;full][/previewyoutube]
As of today, we’ve added a few new features to YOLKED as well as bug fixes and adjustments to help your egg on its escape journey.

[h2]Patch 0.1[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve started using the FMOD Sound Engine for greater control over custom sound in-game!
[*] Experience environment-aware music that changes as you progress through Kitchen and Attic levels
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes & Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added controller support image to the intro splash screen
[*] Emphasized egg cracks to be darker and more visible
[*] Improved ketchup/mustard enemy warning timing and visibility
[*] Improved rolling pin enemy warning timing and visibility
[*] Simplified far-distance high-poly objects in the Kitchen
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented egg arms from grabbing objects when using a controller
[*] Expanded egg push-up maneuver to allow for push-ups at various arm distances
[*] Added a blocker to the ceiling fan section of the Kitchen to prevent player eggs from getting stuck
[/list]
[h2]COMING SOON[/h2]
Patch 0.2 on November 25

Did the Attic level cliffhanger make you jump in our first Early Access build? 😲 On November 25th, we’re expanding the Attic to hold additional challenges, adding new default skins and even hiding a few more collectibles to unlock with your egg physics prowess!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323188/134f266ac326d1b7d0c72411605f04711a25ad01.gif[/img]
